description.value: The Upper Skeena Recreation Centre is a full-service community recreation facility in Hazelton, operated by Recreation Excellence on behalf of the Regional District of Kitimat-Stikine. Situated on Highway 62 in the remote northern BC Skeena corridor, it houses an NHL-size ice arena, full gymnasium, weight room, and cardio area. For touring cyclists passing through this isolated region, the centre offers showers, lockers, and a barrier-free drinking fountain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is well-populated and confirms the facility address (2755 Hwy 62, Hazelton, BC, V0J 1Y0), phone (250-842-6662), and email. Washrooms and showers are confirmed by multiple references to gendered change rooms and a universal change room with 'barrier free sink, toilet, shower and lockers.' A 'barrier free drinking fountain' is explicitly listed under building features, confirming potable water on site. No bike-specific parking, racks, or cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
